firm_data.firm_description: Sinel & Olesen, PLLC is a law firm specializing in general liability, personal injury, medical malpractice, and bedsore lawsuits. They fight for victims of bedsore neglect and hold hospitals and nursing homes accountable.
notable_facts: Over 50 years of experience in personal injury
Specialize in bedsore cases arising from nursing home and hospital neglect

email.subject: AI for Sinel & Olesen, PLLC - built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Elliot,

With over 5,000 bedsore clients served, Sinel & Olesen has built something rare: deep expertise and trust in a practice area most firms won't touch. That scale of impact takes precision, not just hustle.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in New York to meet regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your office to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
